name: stage_handtuned_proto_steps_v1_gaitcycle_v2
description: v2 of the gait-cycle A/B. v1 measured: 1536 aborted_wobble, 247 aborted_timeout, 3 aborted_low_progress, 0 good cycles in 45 min — so the v1 thresholds (2 mm max backward, 5 mm min progress) were 3-5x tighter than the actual proto-stepping motion scale. v1 last completed cycle had net_progress=3.1 mm. v2 relaxes both bars to match observed scale: max_backward 2 mm → 10 mm (sub-cm backward excursion is normal during gait recoveries, not 'hacking'); min_progress 5 mm → 2 mm (match the 3 mm cycle-scale displacement observed). Pulse magnitude and window unchanged. Hypothesis: with thresholds calibrated to actual motion, the pulse fires often enough to provide a real gradient toward forward-displacing cycles.
